question: Which is the governing body for Badminton in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton Association of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Badminton Association of India (BAI)** is the national governing body for **badminton** in India.
 
• It was formed in **1934** and is responsible for **organizing tournaments, promoting the sport,** and selecting players&l
